name: Schierlitz ISD
aliases: TVT versus TOT in intrinsic sphincter deficiency
question: Does retropubic tension-free vaginal tape reduce persistent stress incontinence compared with transobturator tape in women with intrinsic sphincter deficiency?

design.population: Women with urodynamic stress urinary incontinence and intrinsic sphincter deficiency, with or without concomitant pelvic organ prolapse repair.
design.description: Randomized controlled trial at two Australian urogynecology centers
design.locator: Primary PubMed abstract, Methods; ICS author abstract, Results (arm allocation)

verdictNote: Urodynamic stress incontinence at six months was lower after retropubic TVT.
takeaway: Retropubic tension-free vaginal tape reduced urodynamic stress incontinence at six months versus transobturator tape in women with intrinsic sphincter deficiency (14/67 versus 32/71 assessed; P=.004).

reports.label: Six-month primary report
reports.dateLocator: Crossref, published-print date-parts: December 2008; PubMed citation
reports.citation: Schierlitz L, Dwyer PL, Rosamilia A, et al. "Effectiveness of Tension-Free Vaginal Tape Compared With Transobturator Tape in Women With Stress Urinary Incontinence and Intrinsic Sphincter Deficiency: A Randomized Controlled Trial." *Obstet Gynecol.* 2008;112(6):1253-1261. doi:10.1097/AOG.0b013e31818db391

results.measure: Presence of urodynamic stress incontinence at 6 months among women assessed urodynamically
results.note: Outcome available for 138 of 164 randomized women.
Arm denominators for this outcome are not stated in the abstract.

reports.label: Three-year follow-up
reports.dateLocator: Crossref, published-print date-parts: February 2012; PubMed citation
reports.citation: Schierlitz L, Dwyer PL, Rosamilia A, et al. "Three-Year Follow-Up of Tension-Free Vaginal Tape Compared With Transobturator Tape in Women With Stress Urinary Incontinence and Intrinsic Sphincter Deficiency." *Obstet Gynecol.* 2012;119(2 Pt 1):321-327. doi:10.1097/AOG.0b013e31823dfc73

results.endpoint: Repeat surgery for stress urinary incontinence
results.measure: Symptomatic stress incontinence requiring repeat surgery at 3 years
results.note: RR compares transobturator tape with retropubic TVT, reversing the displayed arm order.

results.measure: UDI short form, IIQ short form, and patient-rated success score at 3 years
results.note: The abstract reports no between-group difference on these measures.
